explication: OpenChoreo is a Kubernetes developer platform. The principal workflow is: developers or platform engineers submit high-level intent through the portal, CLI, or agents; the Control Plane authorizes and persists Kubernetes-native abstractions; controllers reconcile them, rendering component, project, resource, and workflow manifests through CEL; Kubernetes runs the resulting workloads; the Observability Plane exposes runtime signals and analytics. The tree and excerpts directly support rendering, deployment-pipeline API behavior, workflow prerequisites, authorization, CLI persistence, and observability structure; portal, CI, and GitOps links remain documentation-based or optional.
